recreation_brief:
1. Create a new PowerPoint slide with a light gray background (#f0f0f0).
2. Draw a thin red rectangle border (#c00000) around the entire slide content area.
3. Add a solid black bar (#000000) along the bottom edge.
4. Insert the title 'Introduction to Artificial Neural Networks (ANN)' centered near the top in large bold red sans-serif text (#c00000).
5. Below the title, centered, add 'CSAI 253 - Spring 2024' in blue sans-serif text (#000080).
6. In the center of the slide, add 'Prepared By' in red, then on the next line 'Dr. Khaled Mostafa ElSayed' in blue, then 'kmelsayed@zewailcity.edu.eg' in smaller blue text below.
7. Bottom-left: add 'Instructors:' in bold red, then list 'Dr. Khaled Mostafa ElSayed' and its email 'kmelsayed@zewailcity.edu.eg', then 'Dr. Mohamed Maher Ata' and its email 'momaher@zewailcity.edu.eg', all in blue sans-serif.
8. Top-right: place a small circle with purple outline containing the number '1'.
9. Bottom-right: insert the Zewail City of Science and Technology logo box with teal left panel and white right panel showing Arabic text 'جامعة العلوم والتكنولوجيا زويل' and English 'University of Science and Technology'.
10. Ensure all text is left-aligned within its block except title and course code which are centered.
